decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 6th March 2006, the erection of a single storey rear infill extension with dimensions 1.595 metres wide, 6.460 metres deep, and 2.95 metres high, returning a volume of 30.49 cu. m, giving a total volume increase to the original house of 49.63 cubic metres, as shown on drawing numbers 01, received 06th March 2006, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed extensions consisting of a single storey side rear extension, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1,Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of single storey rear/side extension to existing kitchen and replacement of existing rear window on ground floor to door to existing house.
